text: DESK KNOB E6 — USB-C interface and ESD protection
USBLC6-2SC6: USB 2.0 data ESD clamp; VBUS reference = 5V
DESK KNOB E6 — USB power and switched peripherals
TLV75533: 5V USB to 3.3V; 500mA rated; C5/C6 ceramic
TPS22919: 1.5A load switch; PB2 low disables LCD and IR
DESK KNOB E6 — STM32 controller and JST programming
VBAT tied to VDD; NRST uses internal pull-up and C13
DESK KNOB E6 — Optical rotation encoder
TCUT1600: dual optical channels; 150R IR drive, nominal 14mA
SN74LVC2G17: 3.3V Schmitt buffers to TIM3 quadrature
DESK KNOB E6 — Persistent turn storage
DESK KNOB E6 — User controls and status
PA0 internal pull-up; short press selects mode; hold 3s clears turns
DESK KNOB E6 — Round display and laptop dashboard
J6: keyed JST-SH 8-pin; H1 crimped SH-to-PH cable; anchors to GND
5V USB / 3.3V logic / suspend-controlled display and encoder
48-slot optical ring / common-collector dual sensor / TIM3 quadrature
Front side button / Scroll or Count mode / hold 3s to clear turns
